LAW OFFICES OF SAMPLE & PARTNERS
Attorneys for Plaintiff MARIA SANCHEZ

SUPERIOR COURT OF THE STATE OF CALIFORNIA, COUNTY OF VENTURA

MARIA SANCHEZ, individually and on behalf of all others similarly situated, and as a representative of the State of California,
Plaintiff,
v.
PACIFIC COAST FRESH, INC., a California corporation; and DOES 1 through 50, inclusive,
Defendants.

Case No. 26CV07731
CLASS AND REPRESENTATIVE ACTION COMPLAINT FOR DAMAGES AND CIVIL PENALTIES
Complaint Filed: September 8, 2026

1. Plaintiff MARIA SANCHEZ, an individual, brings this action on behalf of herself and a class of current and former non-exempt employees of Defendant PACIFIC COAST FRESH, INC.
2. The Class is defined as: All current and former hourly, non-exempt employees of Defendant in California at any time from four years before the filing of this Complaint through the date of class certification.
3. On information and belief, the class consists of more than 55 current and former employees.
4. Defendant required employees to work through their meal periods and failed to provide timely, uninterrupted 30-minute meal periods before the end of the fifth hour of work, and failed to pay one additional hour of pay for each workday a meal period was not provided.
5. Defendant failed to authorize and permit rest periods of ten minutes for every four hours worked or major fraction thereof.
6. Defendant failed to pay overtime at the regular rate of pay because it excluded nondiscretionary bonuses from the regular rate.
7. Defendant failed to reimburse employees for the use of personal cell phones required for work, in violation of Labor Code section 2802.
8. Defendant failed to provide accurate itemized wage statements as required by Labor Code section 226(a).

FIRST CAUSE OF ACTION Failure to Provide Meal Periods (Lab. Code §§ 226.7, 512) (Against All Defendants)
9. Plaintiff incorporates the preceding paragraphs.
SECOND CAUSE OF ACTION Failure to Authorize and Permit Rest Periods (Lab. Code § 226.7) (Against All Defendants)
10. Plaintiff incorporates the preceding paragraphs.
THIRD CAUSE OF ACTION Failure to Pay Overtime Wages (Lab. Code §§ 510, 1194) (Against All Defendants)
11. Plaintiff incorporates the preceding paragraphs.
FOURTH CAUSE OF ACTION Failure to Reimburse Business Expenses (Lab. Code § 2802) (Against All Defendants)
12. Plaintiff incorporates the preceding paragraphs.
FIFTH CAUSE OF ACTION Failure to Provide Accurate Wage Statements (Lab. Code § 226) (Against All Defendants)
13. Plaintiff incorporates the preceding paragraphs.
SIXTH CAUSE OF ACTION Violation of Business and Professions Code Section 17200 (Against All Defendants)
14. Defendant's violations constitute unfair competition.
SEVENTH CAUSE OF ACTION Civil Penalties Under the Private Attorneys General Act (Lab. Code § 2699) (Against All Defendants)
15. On June 15, 2026, Plaintiff gave written notice to the Labor and Workforce Development Agency and to Defendant of the violations alleged herein.
PRAYER FOR RELIEF: Plaintiff prays for unpaid premiums, wages, penalties, interest, and attorneys' fees.
